verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the mobile app supports plugins, tabs, command palette, and a custom editing toolbar (obsidian-docs-34, obsidian-docs-14/25), implying core vault linking/search features carry over since notes are just local Markdown files (obsidian-docs-20). However, community feedback flags a specific gap — no quick-capture 'Google Keep-like' view on mobile (obsidian-comm-14) — showing the mobile experience isn't a full 1:1 parity with desktop. Missing for 10: independent hands-on comparison confirming full search/graph/linking parity on mobile, and evidence addressing the noted quick-capture gap.
